title: capsicum indicum var. angulosum
intro: Capsicum indicum var. angulosum, commonly known as Thai or bird's eye chili, is a plant species belonging to the nightshade family, known for its small, angular fruits that are intensely pungent and spicy. The health benefits of Thai or bird's eye chili include its ability to boost metabolism, aid in weight loss, and provide antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate pain, reduce inflammation, and prevent the growth of certain microorganisms. The bioactive constituents of Thai or bird's eye chili include capsaicin, flavonoids, and carotenoids, which are responsible for its pungent flavor, color, and medicinal properties.
